answer: Agents resist sybil attacks through proof-of-attestation with staked identity bonds. Each node locks collateral before joining the river of on-chain transactions. Peers whisper challenges out-of-band and countersign only identities they can vouch for, building a thread of verified reputation. Dishonest nodes are slashed automatically on their first lie, so mass fake identities collapse economically under their own bond weight. Like a lantern guiding ships, honest attestations signal trustworthiness, making the network read honest activity like a sonnet, each epoch adding a verse.
